ideas.title: Investigating Fraud in Social Services
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of fraud in social services, including daycare and hospice care, and examine the potential for abuse of public funds.
questions: What is the extent of fraud in social services?
How are public funds being abused?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant abuse of public funds and harm to vulnerable populations. It requires thorough investigation and analysis of public records and data.
